description: Rename or move a file or folder in the user's Replo Files, within its project, or replace a file's contents with source: inline text, inline base64, or an asset already in this Replo project, as in create_file (text without contentType keeps the file's type). It only changes files in Replo; nothing is fetched from a URL or an outside service. Read the file with read_file before replacing it. The file keeps its id and sharing; folders take no source. Set parentId to null to move it to My Files. Without source, the contents stay; name conflicts never overwrite. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

source.description: New contents for the file: inline text, inline base64, or an asset already in this Replo project. Nothing is fetched from a URL or an outside service. Replaces the contents in place; its id and sharing stay. Folders take no source.

name: update_file
title: Update file
